sections.heading: A second past tense
sections.body: Spanish has two main simple past tenses. The preterite tells what happened. The imperfect (*el imperfecto*) describes how things **used to be** or **were going on**: habits, repeated actions, and background. *Cuando era niño, jugaba al fútbol todos los días.* (When I was a child, I used to play soccer every day.)

sections.heading: Past habits
sections.body:
The imperfect is the natural tense for "used to" and "would" (for habits). Typical signals: *antes* (before, in the past), *de niño / de niña* (as a child), *cuando era joven* (when I was young), *siempre, todos los días, a menudo, normalmente, cada verano* (every summer).

*Antes vivía en Chicago.* (I used to live in Chicago.) *De niña, iba a la playa cada verano.* (As a girl, I went to the beach every summer.) *Hay* becomes *había* (there was / there were): *Había un parque cerca de mi casa.*

vocab: I/he/she used to go / was going
examples: Cuando era niño, jugaba al fútbol todos los días.
When I was a child, I used to play soccer every day.
Antes vivía en Chicago.
I used to live in Chicago.
De niña, iba a la playa cada verano.
As a girl, I went to the beach every summer.
Mi abuela cocinaba muy bien.
My grandmother used to cook very well.
Veíamos dibujos animados los sábados.
We used to watch cartoons on Saturdays.
Había un parque cerca de mi casa.
There was a park near my house.
Mis padres trabajaban mucho.
My parents used to work a lot.
¿Dónde vivías antes?
Where did you use to live?
Éramos muy amigos.
We were very close friends.
Montaba en bicicleta con mis vecinos.
I used to ride my bike with my neighbors.
Mi pueblo era muy tranquilo.
My town was very quiet.
Siempre comíamos juntos los domingos.
We always used to eat together on Sundays.
Íbamos a la escuela a pie.
We used to walk to school.
Mi abuelo leía el periódico cada mañana.
My grandfather used to read the newspaper every morning.
Ella era profesora.
She was a teacher.
No me gustaba el pescado.
I didn't like fish.
Tenía un perro que se llamaba Max.
I had a dog named Max.
Escuchábamos la radio.
We used to listen to the radio.
Mis hermanos dormían en el mismo cuarto.
My brothers used to sleep in the same room.
Antes hablabas muy poco.
You used to talk very little.
Cuando era joven, bailaba mucho.
When I was young, I used to dance a lot.
Veía la televisión con mi padre.
I used to watch TV with my father.
Iban al pueblo cada verano.
They used to go to the village every summer.
Vivíamos en una casa grande.
We lived in a big house.
Mi madre se levantaba muy temprano.
My mother used to get up very early.
